limitations: Desktop Edge on ANGLE AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x00001636), D3D11; mobile widths are viewport/touch emulation, not physical phone performance.
Input-event to next animation-frame opportunity is not physical input-to-photon latency; actual iOS keyboard unavailable.
No universal 60fps or broad speedup claim: before and after were locally responsive; initial brief-edit frame excursions remain below the 100ms local ceiling.
Mocked controller/API receipts verify UI wiring and recovery behavior, not actual paid provider output. No provider calls or production writes.
